questions.question:
**In the following question, some part of the sentence may have errors. Find out which part of the sentence has an error and select the appropriate option. If a sentence is free from error, select 'No Error'.**

How did they become (1)/ the most successful investors (2)/ America have ever seen? (3)/ No error (4).
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 3**

Here, concept of past tense is brought under consideration. Since, the starter of the sentence has verb **did **of past tense. Thus, same pattern to be followed in whole sentence. So, replace **have **with **had. **Thus, option 3 is the correct answer.

**Correct sentence - **How did they become the most successful investors America had ever seen?

questions.question:
**In the following question, some part of the sentence may have errors. Find out which part of the sentence has an error and select the appropriate option. If a sentence is free from error, select 'No Error'.**

He found comfort in fantasy and (1)/ science-ﬁction books which inspiring (2)/ him to leave a legacy in the world. (3)/ No error (4)
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 2**

Here, concept of past tense is brought under consideration. Since, the starter of the sentence has verb of simple past tense i.e. **found. **Hence, same pattern should be followed in the complete sentence. So, replace **inspiring **with **inspired. **Thus, option 2 is the correct answer.

**Correct sentence - **He found comfort in fantasy and science-ﬁction books which inspired him to leave a legacy in the world.

questions.question:
**In the following question, the sentence given with blank to be ﬁlled in with an appropriate word. Select the correct alternative out of the four and indicate it by selecting the appropriate option.**

Nobody will help you but ______.
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 2**

Here, concept of subject pronoun is brought under consideration. Since, conjunction is used between same type of speech. Pronoun **you **is used as both subject pronoun or object pronoun. Firstly, pronouns** my & mine **are possessive pronouns. Thus, options 1 & 3 are eliminated. Again, **their **is a possessive pronoun. Hence, option 4 is eliminated. So, option 2 i.e. **I **is the correct answer.

**Correct sentence - **Nobody will help you but I.

questions.question:
**In the following question, the sentence given with blank to be ﬁlled in with an appropriate word. Select the correct alternative out of the four and indicate it by selecting the appropriate option.**

One must not praise ______ self.
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 4**

Here, topic of objective pronoun(reflexive pronoun) is brought under consideration. Since, object pronoun is used according to the subject pronoun. Here, subject pronoun is **one, **then object pronoun which should be used is **oneself. **Hence, option 4 i.e. **one **is the correct answer.

**Correct sentence - **One must not praise oneself.

questions.question:
**In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the one which best expresses the meaning of the given word.**

FORBID
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 3**

Firstly, let's find out the meaning of given word 'forbid' :- To command a person or animal not to do a particular thing; to prohibit; to prevent; to exclude.

Now, we check the meaning of given options :-

Include - To contain; intake.

Standout - Someone or something, as a person, performance, etc., that is far better than others.

Preclude - To prevent the presence, existence, or occurrence of; make impossible.

Welcome - A kindly greeting or reception.

Clearly, the word **preclude **best expresses the meaning of 'forbid'. Hence, option 3 i.e. **preclude **is the correct answer.

Now, get to the meaning of given options :-

Hardworking - An industrious person; laborious.

Plump - Well filled out or rounded in form.

Healthy - A person having good health; fit.

Exhausted - A person who is very tired; lethargic.

Thus, the word **exhausted**** **best expresses the meaning of given word 'haggard'. So, option 4 i.e. **exhausted **is the correct answer.

Clearly, the word **innocuous **best expresses the meaning of given word 'insipid'. Hence, option 1 i.e. **innocuous **is the correct answer.

questions.question:
**Improve the bracketed part of the sentence.**

The consequences of her removal (inside the) meeting of the general counsel of the party will be immediate.
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 3**

Here, topic of preposition is brought under consideration. Meeting is an act of coming together, assembling to discuss things or make decisions. It is not a place, or thing, etc. which can be used to go inside it. Hence, option 4 is eliminated. Now, decisions are taken while the meeting is going on, but not before or after it. Hence, option 2 is eliminated. If we use preposition **on **then we need to define a certain day or place. For example - On Friday meeting. So, option 1 is eliminated. Whereas, **at the **will be directly related with **meeting. **Hence, option 3 i.e. **at the **is the correct answer.

**Correct sentence - **The consequences of her removal at the meeting of the general counsel of the party will be immediate.

questions.question:
**Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order.**

There was a

P: the river, from one

Q: thick rope tied across

R: bank to the another
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 4**

Clearly, a sentence does not end with a preposition. Hence, option 3 is eliminated. Now, the starter ends with an article **a**, thus it cannot follow another article **the. **Thus, option 1 is eliminated. There are certain prepositions which are used in pair such as from....to, it shows time or place from start to end. Hence, it should be in correct order of **from...to**. Thus, option 2 is eliminated. Hence, option 4 i.e. **QPR **is the correct answer.

**Correct sentence - **There was a thick rope tied across the river, from one bank to the another.

questions.question: the fact of ______ in diversity.

Relativity - The state of being connected with other person or thing.

Creativity - Having to transform traditional ideas, rules, patterns, etc.

Clearly, options 2, 3 & 4 are out of context. Because India has always set an example of country with unity in diversity. So, option 1 i.e. **unity **is the correct answer.

questions.question: for many years without ______ problem

**Correct option - 2**

Here, concept of adjective is brought under consideration. Since, word **without **is a preposition used to define absence, omission or avoidance of something. Also, adjective **any **is used to define without. That is having nothing. So, option 2 i.e. **any **is the correct answer. That is, people of various religions and castes have managed to live together for many years without any problem.

questions.question: ancient culture and ______,
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 3**

Firstly, let's find out the meaning of the given options :-

Festival - A day or time of religious or other celebrations.

Rites - A formal or ceremonial act or procedure prescribed in a religion.

Tradition - Continuing the legacy of beliefs, customs, information, etc., from one generation to another generation.

Themes - A subject of discussion; topic; etc.

With reference to the context, word **culture **is mainly connected with tradition. Because, culture means the behaviours and beliefs characteristic of a particular social, ethnic, or age group, etc. So, option 3 i.e. **tradition **is the correct answer. That is, India is decorated by the high mountains, valleys, oceans, famous rivers, streams, forests, deserts, ancient culture and tradition.

questions.question: all have ______ characteristic

**Correct option - 4**

With reference to the context of the sentence, in India, people of different race, religion and language have the same feature of humanity & kindness. Words **dislike & unlike **gives contradiction to the context. And, **nominal **means so-called; in name only. But, humanity is not that is done for namesake. Hence, options 1, 2 & 3 are eliminated. Thus, option 4 i.e. **similar **is the correct answer. That is, People here belong to their own race, religion and language however they all have similar characteristic of humanity which make them able to live together.

questions.question: If 4 years ago the ratio of the ages of P and Q was 5 : 6 and the sum of their ages at present is 52, then what is the ratio of their present ages?
questions.solution:
Let the ages in ratio be 5x and 6x of P and Q respectively.

It is the ratio of their age 4 years ago from the present age.

Present age of P = 5x + 4

Q = 6x + 4

Given that sum of present age is 52.

Therefore,

5x + 4 + 6x + 4 = 52

11x + 8 = 52

11x = 44

X = 4

Putting x = 4, there present age of P would be 5(4) + 4 = 20 + 4 = 24

Age of Q = 6(4) + 4 = 24 + 4 = 28

Ratio of presents age = 24: 28

 = 6: 7

Hence, option 2 is the correct answer.

questions.question: In a certain code language, "NIP" is written as "38" and "NIB" is written as "24". How is "HEX" written in that code language?

questions.question: Which of the following number is divisible by 15?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

A number is **divisible by 15** if it is divisible by both **3** and **5**.

Check for **5**: Unit digit must be 0 or 5 (Options 2, 3, 4 satisfy this).

Check for **3**: **Sum of digits** must be divisible by 3.

For 11115: 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 5 = 9. Since 9 is **divisible by 3**, 11115 is divisible by 15.

**∴ The correct answer is 11115.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Numbers (1) 73246, (2) 23450, (3) 11115, (4) 24095.

**Divisibility Rule for 15:** Number must satisfy divisibility of 3 and 5.

⇒ **Divisibility by 5:** (2) 23450, (3) 11115, and (4) 24095 end in 0 or 5.

⇒ **Divisibility by 3 for (2):** 2 + 3 + 4 + 5 + 0 = 14 (Not divisible by 3).

⇒ **Divisibility by 3 for (3):** 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 5 = 9 (Divisible by 3).

⇒ **Divisibility by 3 for (4):** 2 + 4 + 0 + 9 + 5 = 20 (Not divisible by 3).

⇒ Since 11115 is divisible by both 3 and 5, it is divisible by 15.

**∴ The correct answer is 11115.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Divisibility Rule of 3

A number is divisible by 3 if the **sum of its digits** is a multiple of 3.

Divisibility Rule of 5

A number is divisible by 5 if its **last digit** is either 0 or 5.

Composite Divisibility

For a number to be divisible by a **composite number** (like 15), it must be divisible by its **co-prime factors** (3 and 5).</p

questions.question: How many multiples of both 3 or 4 are there from 1 to 100 in total?
questions.solution:
**Formula used:**

n(A∪B) = n(A) + n(B) - n(A∩B)

**Calculation:**

On dividing 100 by 3 we get a quotient of 33

The number of multiple of 3, n(A) = 33

On dividing 100 by 4 we get a quotient of 25

The number of multiple of 4, n(B) = 25

LCM of 3 and 4 is 12

On dividing 100 by 12 we get a quotient of 8

The number of multiple of 12, n(A∩B) = 8

The number which is multiple of 3 or 4 = n(A∪B)

Now, n(A∪B) = n(A) + n(B) - n(A∩B)

⇒ 33 + 25 - 8

⇒ 50

**∴ The total number multiple of 3 or 4 is 50**

questions.question: A merchant purchases a watch for Rs. 560 and ﬁxes its marked price in such a way that even after allowing a discount of 20%, he earns a proﬁt of 40%. What is the marked price (in Rs) of the watch?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Cost price = Rs. 560

Discount = 20%

Profit = 40%

**Formula used:**

SP = CP × (100 + Profit%)/100

SP = MP × (100 - Discount%)/100

**Calculations:**

SP = CP × (100 + Profit%)/100

⇒ SP = 560 × (100 + 40)/100

⇒ SP = 560 × 140/100

⇒ SP = Rs. 784

SP = MP × (100 - Discount%)/100

⇒ SP = MP × (100 - 20)/100

⇒ 784 = MP × 80/100

⇒ 784 = 4MP/5

⇒ MP = Rs. 980

**∴ The marked price of the watch is Rs. 980.**

 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**

CP : MP = (100 - Discount%) : (100 + Profit%)

⇒ 560 : MP = (100 - 20) : (100 + 40)

⇒ 560/MP = 80/140

⇒ 560/MP = 4/7

⇒ MP = Rs. 980

∴ The marked price of the watch is Rs. 980.

Solving equation (1) and (2)

a = 640

Income of X = 3a = 3 × 640 = Rs. 1920

The average of N numbers is 10. If a number 6 is removed, then average becomes 12. What is the value of N?
questions.solution:
Average of N numbers = sum of N numbers/N

⇒ 10 = sum of N numbers/N

⇒ sum of N numbers = 10N

A number 6 is removed,

New average = 12

N’ = N - 1

Sum of N’ numbers = sum of N numbers - 6 = 10N - 6

New average = Sum of N’ numbers/N’

⇒ 12 = (10N - 6)/(N - 1)

⇒ 12N - 12 = 10N - 6

⇒ 2N = 6

⇒ N = 3

questions.question: A man sold 250 chairs and had a gain equal to selling price of 50 chairs. What is his proﬁt percentage?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Gain = SP of 50 chairs

**Formula Used:**

SP = CP + Profit

Profit% = (Profit/CP) × 100

**Calculations:**

Profit in selling 250 chairs = 50 S.P.

Profit in selling 1 chair = 50/250 S.P. = 0.2 S.P.

Profit = S.P. - C.P.

⇒ 0.2 S.P = S.P. - C.P.

⇒ C.P = 0.8 S.P.

Now, Profit% = (Profit/CP) × 100

⇒ Profit percentage = (0.2 × S.P./0.8 × S.P.) × 100 = 25%

**∴ The proﬁt percentage of man is 25%.**

questions.question: Number of RBC in an adult man per 3 ml of blood is ________.
questions.solution:
Number of RBC in an adult man per 3ml of blood is **5000000.**

__**Explanation-**__

 
• The number of red blood cells (RBCs), also known as erythrocytes, can vary between individuals and populations.
 
• An average range would be approximately 4.5 to 5.5 million RBCs per microliter (or cubic millimeter) of blood in adult men.
 
• To calculate the number of RBCs in 3 milliliters (mL) of blood, we first need to understand that 1 milliliter equals 1,000 microliters (μL). Hence, 3 milliliters equals 3,000 μL.
 
• Therefore, if we calculate using an average value of 5 million RBCs per μL:
 
• 5 million RBCs/μL x 3,000 μL = 15 trillion RBCs

So, on average, an adult man might have around 15 trillion red blood cells in 3 milliliters of blood. Actual RBC counts can vary based on a variety of factors, including overall health, altitude, and individual biological differences.

questions.question: An echo will be heard if the minimum distance between the source of the sound and the obstacle is ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 4) i.e. 17 m

__CONCEPT:__

__
 
• Echo: The sound heard after it gets reflected from a rigid surface is called an echo.

 
 
• Echo is received by the listener with a delay after the original sound is produced.
 
• This delay occurs as the original sound persists in our ear for 0.1 s.
 
 

​​EXPLANATION:__

 
• The original sound persists in our ear for 0.1 s. So to hear an echo, the reflected sound must be reaching our ears at least after 0.1 s.
 
• Assuming the speed of sound in air as 340 m/s, we can calculate the distance travelled by the sound

⇒ D = speed × time = 340 x 0.1 = 34 m.

 
• This 34 m is the combined to and fro distance from the source to the reflected surface.

So, one way distance = 34/2 = 17 m.

 
• Hence, 17 m is the minimum distance required between the reflecting surface and source to hear an echo.

questions.question: Which of the following class of forces is different from others?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Electrical force**

__**Explanation:-**__

 
• **Pulling a wooden block**: Pulling a wooden block is an instance of a **mechanical force - specifically, a contact force.** It arises due to the direct physical interaction of two entities—in this case, a person (or another object) and a wooden block. This pulling force results from the force exerted by a person's hand or another device making direct contact with the block. Because it's derived from tangible interaction, it's classified as a contact/mechanical force.
 
• **Stretching a coiled spring:** This is another example of a **mechanical force known as an elastic force. When a coiled spring is stretched, it attempts to return to its original shape **and, in response, generates a force that opposes the stretching action. This force is exerted along the line of contact between the hand (or another object) and the spring, making it a contact/mechanical force.
 
• **Pushing a wall: **Pushing a wall, like pulling a wooden block, **involves a mechanical contact force.** Contact force is experienced when a person's hand is directly pushing against a wall, leading to a physical interaction between two entities—the hand and the wall. Once again, it's a mechanical force as it results from a tangible interaction.
 
• **Electrical force: This force stands out as different from the other three due to its nature. Electrical force is a non-contact force and is one of the four basic forces in nature**—the others being gravity, the strong force, and the weak force. It operates between charged particles, with like charges repelling each other and opposite charges attracting each other. The crucial distinction is that electrical force does not require direct physical contact to operate; it can act at a distance, unlike the other forces listed here

The electrical force is different from the rest of them. It is the attractive or repulsive interaction between 2 charged objects.

questions.question: The symbiotic relation between algae and _______ is lichen.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __Lichen.__
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The symbiotic relation between algae and fungus in lichen
 
• A lichen is a complex life form that forms as a result of algae and fungus.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__** 

__
 
• Lichen is a special kind of plant made up of the Algal component and fungal component exhibiting* *symbiotic association with each other in which both components are benefited viz., fungal components provide substratum and absorb mineral and water whereas algal component performs photosynthesis and provide food to a fungal component.
 
• Algae prepare food for fungi as it is photosynthetic whereas fungi provide shelter and absorb minerals and water for algae.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

Symbiotic Relationship:

 
• The word symbiosis comes from the Greek 'sym' and 'bios', which translated means together and life, or life working together. 
 
• Symbiosis is an adjacent relationship between two classes in which at least one species benefits.
 
• There are three basic types of symbiosis:

 
 

 Mutualism
 Both partner benefits
 
 

 Commensalism
 Only one species benefits while the other is neither helped nor harmed.
 
 

 Parasitism
 One organism (the parasite) gains, while the other (the host) suffers.
